Waybill.cbc:Name: Consignment note under the road convention, the CMR
Waybill.cbc:Note: Three originals: the consignor's, handed over when the carrier took over the goods; the consignee's, with the goods; the carrier's, kept by the carrier.
Waybill.cbc:OtherInstruction: Deliver against signature of the consignee.

cac:Shipment.cbc:Information: Park benches, knocked down, and spare side frames, for resale.

cac:Consignment.cbc:SummaryDescription: Park benches and spare side frames on 25 pallets.
cac:Consignment.cbc:Remarks: Received in apparent good order; trailer doors sealed by the 3PL, seal as recorded.
cac:Consignment.cbc:CustomsClearanceServiceInstructions: The export is declared by the seller in Ferrano; the import by the distributor at the border.
cac:Consignment.cbc:DeliveryInstructions: Enter by gate 3 of the business park and report to the gatehouse; unload at dock 4.
cac:Consignment.cbc:HaulageInstructions: Wait at the warehouse until customs has released the export declaration.

cac:DeliveryTerms.cbc:SpecialTerms: The buyer's carrier presents the truck; the seller loads it.
cac:DeliveryTerms.cbc:LossRisk: The risk passes on loading at the 3PL's warehouse.

cac:CollectPaymentTerms.cbc:Note: The freight is paid by the consignee under its contract with the carrier.
